scenarios.name: normal_stream_and_pit_restore
scenarios.injection: none
scenarios.notes: Baseline CDC capture, physical backup and same-major PITR with source/target truth comparison

scenarios.name: exact_duplicate_replay
scenarios.injection: replay exact event envelopes
scenarios.notes: Exact replay with identical key, envelope and payload is deduplicated but recorded

scenarios.name: explicit_row_stream_scope
scenarios.injection: declare out-of-scope surfaces
scenarios.notes: Row-stream claim may pass only with exact explicit exclusion manifest

scenarios.name: connector_restart_after_commit
scenarios.injection: kill Connect after a source transaction commit; restart Connect
scenarios.notes: Immediately after restart, continuity remains indeterminate until an independent event-set and offset reconciliation proves no loss or conflicting replay.

scenarios.name: connector_crash_mid_transaction
scenarios.injection: terminate Connect during a multi-row transaction
scenarios.notes: A crash mid-transaction is indeterminate until transaction-envelope closure is independently reconciled; a proven missing member blocks.

scenarios.name: broker_restart_after_produce
scenarios.injection: stop Kafka broker after event production and before offset/consumer reconciliation
scenarios.notes: Observed output and offset durability must be reconciled independently

scenarios.name: source_immediate_shutdown
scenarios.injection: immediate stop PostgreSQL with outstanding WAL/slot state
scenarios.notes: Restart and reconcile duplicate/replayed WAL before declaring continuity

scenarios.name: conflicting_duplicate_event
scenarios.injection: replay same event ID with altered payload digest
scenarios.notes: Same identity with conflicting content is divergence

scenarios.name: missing_expected_event
scenarios.injection: remove one expected event from independently read Kafka data
scenarios.notes: Source truth vs Kafka event set mismatch blocks continuity

scenarios.name: transaction_membership_gap
scenarios.injection: omit one member of a multi-row transaction
scenarios.notes: Transaction envelope closure fails

scenarios.name: publication_filter_change
scenarios.injection: change publication/table filter after baseline
scenarios.notes: Scope boundary must be updated and re-attested

scenarios.name: schema_ddl_outside_row_stream
scenarios.injection: add/alter column after connector snapshot
scenarios.notes: DDL change must be surfaced by independent inventory evidence

scenarios.name: generated_column_not_emitted
scenarios.injection: change inputs that alter generated value
scenarios.notes: Row stream cannot imply generated-column state coverage

scenarios.name: sequence_advanced
scenarios.injection: advance sequence independently of row transaction
scenarios.notes: Sequence state requires explicit synchronization/evidence

scenarios.name: large_object_mutated
scenarios.injection: write/replace large-object bytes
scenarios.notes: Large object digest mismatch blocks full-state claim

scenarios.name: materialized_view_stale
scenarios.injection: change base rows without refreshing materialized view
scenarios.notes: Recovered derived state must match declared refresh semantics

scenarios.name: unlogged_table_content_lost
scenarios.injection: write unlogged table before backup/restore
scenarios.notes: Do not infer WAL recoverability of unlogged relation contents

scenarios.name: partition_topology_changed
scenarios.injection: add/drop/attach/detach a partition
scenarios.notes: Inventory and schema/partition digests must change

scenarios.name: wal_archive_gap
scenarios.injection: withhold a WAL segment required by target time
scenarios.notes: Requested PITR target is not reachable

scenarios.name: restore_target_too_early
scenarios.injection: restore to a time before required committed transaction
scenarios.notes: Recovered point must match exact requested target semantics

scenarios.name: restore_target_too_late
scenarios.injection: restore beyond authorized target boundary
scenarios.notes: No forward rounding beyond declared target

scenarios.name: wrong_source_backup
scenarios.injection: restore backup from another system identifier/database
scenarios.notes: Source lineage mismatch blocks

scenarios.name: wrong_timeline
scenarios.injection: supply WAL from incompatible timeline without parent/fork evidence
scenarios.notes: No numeric-only LSN comparison across timelines

scenarios.name: target_surface_mismatch
scenarios.injection: alter one restored state surface while preserving row count
scenarios.notes: Canonical surface digest comparison detects drift

scenarios.name: dependency_unavailable
scenarios.injection: deny one required application dependency
scenarios.notes: Database ready does not promote service ready

scenarios.name: old_primary_unfenced
scenarios.injection: leave former primary accepting writes
scenarios.notes: Activation blocked against split-brain risk

scenarios.name: stale_endpoint_reachable
scenarios.injection: leave stale route/DNS/service endpoint usable
scenarios.notes: All stale endpoints must be fenced before activation

scenarios.name: write_probe_not_rolled_back
scenarios.injection: write test value and omit rollback
scenarios.notes: Service readiness fails until write probe is rolled back and observed

scenarios.name: traffic_before_acceptance
scenarios.injection: enable traffic before independent service acceptance
scenarios.notes: Activation-order invariant violated

scenarios.name: unknown_promotion_outcome
scenarios.injection: time out failover/promotion API and do not query actual role
scenarios.notes: No second mutation until original outcome is reconciled

scenarios.name: observer_common_cause
scenarios.injection: run source, target and observer under one admin root
scenarios.notes: Independent verification claim is unsupported

scenarios.name: clock_uncertainty_unbounded
scenarios.injection: inject drift/uncertainty above declared clock budget
scenarios.notes: RPO/RTO upper bounds cannot be qualified

scenarios.name: backup_checksum_corruption
scenarios.injection: corrupt a backup page or archive artifact
scenarios.notes: Integrity/restore check must fail closed

scenarios.name: connector_config_drift
scenarios.injection: change plugin, slot, publication or snapshot config without new manifest
scenarios.notes: Version and source-scope digest mismatch

scenarios.name: kafka_432_patch_extension
scenarios.injection: run Kafka 4.3.2 against pinned Debezium connector
scenarios.notes: Extension profile requires compatibility and full challenge requalification

scenarios.name: kafka_440_series_extension
scenarios.injection: run Kafka 4.4.0 against pinned Debezium connector
scenarios.notes: New-series compatibility is not assumed from 4.3.1 test note

scenarios.name: pgbackrest_version_mismatch
scenarios.injection: use different local and remote pgBackRest binaries
scenarios.notes: pgBackRest protocol requires exact version alignment

scenarios.name: same_event_id_altered_payload_preserved_row_count
scenarios.injection: alter a Kafka row payload amount while keeping event ID and batch row count unchanged
scenarios.notes: The independent source SQL oracle must detect value divergence even when event counts and primary keys still match.

scenarios.name: transaction_end_event_count_mismatch
scenarios.injection: alter Debezium END event_count or omit one row event from a multi-row transaction
scenarios.notes: A complete set of primary keys does not override a missing BEGIN/END witness, wrong END event_count or non-contiguous per-event ordering.

scenarios.name: exact_transaction_boundary_replay
scenarios.injection: replay byte-identical BEGIN and END transaction topic records while retaining the original records
scenarios.notes: Exact duplicate transaction envelopes are deduplicated and counted as replay, not mistaken for conflicting or missing boundaries.

scenarios.name: conflicting_transaction_boundary_replay
scenarios.injection: reuse one transaction ID with a changed BEGIN or END payload, including a changed END event_count
scenarios.notes: Conflicting boundary metadata under the same transaction ID is divergence even when row events match.
